title: Objects with vanishing cohomology
statement:
For $E\in D(T_{\Et})$ one has $E=0$ if and only if
$\mathcal H^q(E)=0$ for all $q$.

proof.text:
A complex in the localization of
[def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] is zero precisely when it is
acyclic, i.e. all its cohomology sheaves vanish.

lean.statement:
lemma isZero_iff (K : DerivedCategory C) :
    IsZero K ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, IsZero ((homologyFunctor C n).obj K)
lean.note: Existing generic theorem, specialized to C = Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u+1} and K = E, states exactly the node. IsZero renders categorical vanishing; homologyFunctor on cochain complexes is the cohomology-sheaf functor in every integer degree. No boundedness or torsion hypothesis is required.
